 Pinole-Hercules Property Owners Face Dec. 10 Tax Payment Deadline
 Contra Costa County's first secured property tax installment carries a 10% penalty if paid late.
 Patch News , Patch Staff 
 Posted Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 8:08 am PT Pinole and Hercules property owners must pay their first 2026-2027 secured property tax installment by 5 p.m. Thursday, Dec. 10, to avoid a 10% penalty. The Contra Costa County Treasurer-Tax Collector’s Office offers online, phone, mail, in-person and drop-box payment options.
 The first installment was due Sunday, Nov. 1. Owners who had not received a bill by that date should call 925-608-9500, because not receiving a bill does not excuse late payment. Participants in paperless billing receive bills at their registered email address.
 Taxpayers can pay through the tax portal or call the automated payment system at 925-608-9500. PayPal, credit card and debit card payments carry a 2.5% service fee, with a $3.50 minimum. E-checks have no service fee, but rejected e-checks can trigger a returned-check fee of up to $85.

 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . Check payments with installment coupons can be mailed using the provided envelope to P.O. Box 51104, Los Angeles, CA 90051. Timely USPS postmarks are honored. Both installments may be paid together, but both coupons must accompany payment of the entire bill.
 In-person payments are accepted at the Contra Costa County Finance Building, 625 Court St., Suite 100, Martinez, CA 94553, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Friday, excluding holidays. A drive-thru check drop box on the building’s Main Street side normally operates around the clock. It closes at 5 p.m. Thursday, Dec. 10.

 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . The second installment is due Monday, Feb. 1, 2027. Its listed delinquency date, Saturday, April 10, shifts to 5 p.m. Monday, April 12, under the weekend rule. Payments after that deadline incur a 10% penalty and a $20 administrative charge.
 Owners can also sign up for paperless billing . The service provides email reminders and electronic access to bills.
